```{r}
library(lattice)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(Rcpp)
source('helpers.R')
Rcpp::sourceCpp('../src/dualDMC.cpp')
```

## Simulate data
```{r}
# varying parameters
tau1_vals <- seq(30, 230, 50)
tau2_vals <- seq(30, 230, 50)
A1_vals <- seq(10, 25, 5)
A2_vals <- seq(10, 25, 5)

param_grid <- expand.grid(tau1 = tau1_vals, tau2 = tau2_vals, 
                          A1 = A1_vals, A2 = A2_vals)

# constant parameters
param_grid$b      <- 50
param_grid$mu_c   <- 0.5
param_grid$sigma  <- 4 
param_grid$dt     <- 0.01
param_grid$ndt_m  <- 330
param_grid$ndt_sd <- 30


N_sim <- 5000		# number of simulations per parameter set
datDDMC <- simDDMC(param_grid, N_sim)                # simulate
save(datDDMC, file = "out/data/datDDMC.RData")      # save data
```

## Load all simulated datasets
```{r}
dat1 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC1.RData"))
dat2 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC2.RData"))
dat3 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC3.RData"))
dat4 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC4.RData"))
dat5 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC5.RData"))
dat6 <- get(load("out/data/datDDMC6.RData"))

dat1$simulation <- 1
dat2$simulation <- 2
dat3$simulation <- 3
dat4$simulation <- 4
dat5$simulation <- 5
dat6$simulation <- 6

datAll <- rbind(dat1, dat2, dat3, dat4, dat5, dat6)
datAll <- mk_congruency(datAll)
datAll$congruency <- as.factor(datAll$congruency)
datAll$error <- ifelse(datAll$dec == 1, 0, 1)

table(datAll$dec)   # no trials without a decision
summary(datAll$rt)

# RTs, ERs per simulation
aggregate(cbind(rt, error) ~ simulation, FUN = mean, data = datAll)
```


## Heatmaps
```{r}
sim_nr <- 6       # select simulation
dat_nr <- "_6"    # set plot suffix
dat <- datAll[datAll$simulation == sim_nr, ]

print(unique(dat$mu_c))
print(unique(dat$b))

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  tau1 = unique(dat$tau1), tau2 = unique(dat$tau2), 
  A1 = unique(dat$A1), A2 = unique(dat$A2)
)
#print(param_grid)

param_grid$diffs <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  print(paste("processing set :", i))
  param_grid[i, ]$diffs <- check_ceff(
    dat, A1 = param_grid[i,]$A1, A2 = param_grid[i,]$A2, 
    tau1 = param_grid[i,]$tau1, tau2 = param_grid[i,]$tau2, 
    mu_c = unique(dat$mu_c), b = unique(dat$b)
  )
}

summary(param_grid$diffs)
sd(param_grid$diffs)
min(param_grid$diffs)
max(param_grid$diffs)

# Plot heatmaps for differences, vary As
plot_df <- param_grid %>% filter(tau1 == tau2)

pdf(paste0("out/plots/heatmaps/heatmaps_varyAs", dat_nr, ".pdf"), 6, 4)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(A2), y = factor(A1), fill = diffs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = expression(A[2]), y = expression(A[1])) +
  facet_wrap(~ tau1, labeller = label_bquote(
    paste(tau[1], " = ", tau[2], " = ", .(tau1)))
  ) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
dev.off()

# Plot heatmaps for differences, vary taus
plot_df <- param_grid %>% filter(A1 == A2)

#pdf(paste0("../../script/images/heatmaps_varyTaus", dat_nr, ".pdf"), 6, 4)
pdf(paste0("out/plots/heatmaps/heatmaps_varyTaus", dat_nr, ".pdf"), 6, 4)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(tau2), y = factor(tau1), fill = diffs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = expression(tau[2]), y = expression(tau[1])) +
  facet_wrap(~ A1, labeller = label_bquote(
    paste(A[1], " = ", A[2], " = ", .(A1)))
  ) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
dev.off()
```

## Plots vary A1 x A2 / tau1 x tau2
```{r}
sim_nr = 1
dat_nr <- "_1"    # set plot suffix
datDDMC <- datAll[datAll$simulation == sim_nr, ]

summary(datDDMC$rt)
#datDDMC <- datDDMC[datDDMC$rt > 200 & datDDMC$rt < 1500, ]   # Exclusions

# get parameter sets with A1 == A2
df_As_eq <- datDDMC[datDDMC$A1 == datDDMC$A2, ]
df_As_lst <- split(df_As_eq, df_As_eq$A1)
# get parameter sets with tau1 == tau2
df_taus_eq <- datDDMC[datDDMC$tau1 == datDDMC$tau2, ]
df_taus_lst <- split(df_taus_eq, df_taus_eq$tau1)

# Mean RTs
pdf(paste0("out/plots/rt/RT_vary_taus", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_As_lst, plt_means, v1 = "tau1", v2 = "tau2", type = "RT")
dev.off()
pdf(paste0("out/plots/rt/RT_vary_As", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_taus_lst, plt_means, v1 = "A1", v2 = "A2", type = "RT")
dev.off()

# Mean ERs
pdf(paste0("out/plots/er/ER_vary_taus", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_As_lst, plt_means, v1 = "tau1", v2 = "tau2", type = "ER")
dev.off()
pdf(paste0("out/plots/er/ER_vary_As", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_taus_lst, plt_means, v1 = "A1", v2 = "A2", type = "ER")

# CAFs
pdf(paste0("out/plots/caf/CAF_vary_taus", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_As_lst, plt_cafs, n_bins = 4, "tau1", "tau2")
dev.off()
pdf(paste0("out/plots/caf/CAF_vary_As", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_taus_lst, plt_cafs, n_bins = 4, "A1", "A2")
dev.off()

# Delta 
pdf(paste0("out/plots/delta/delta_vary_taus", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_As_lst, plt_delta, "tau1", "tau2")
dev.off()
pdf(paste0("out/plots/delta/delta_vary_As", dat_nr, ".pdf")) 
lapply(df_taus_lst, plt_delta, "A1", "A2")
dev.off()

pdf(paste0("out/plots/delta/delta_vary_taus_cond", dat_nr, ".pdf"))
lapply(df_As_lst, plt_delta, "tau1", "tau2", TRUE)
dev.off()
pdf(paste0("out/plots/delta/delta_vary_As_cond", dat_nr, ".pdf")) 
lapply(df_taus_lst, plt_delta, "A1", "A2", TRUE)
dev.off()
```

## Parameter sets with ER > 0.15 in any condition
```{r}
# first simulation
lapply(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), function(nr) {
  df <- datAll[datAll$simulation == nr, ]
  ers <- aggregate(error ~ congruency + A1 + A2 + tau1 + tau2, df, mean)
  ex <- ers[(ers$congruency == "incongruent_incongruent")& ers$error > 0.15, ] 
  print(nrow(ex))
})
```

## OK parameter sets 
# - mean ER incongruent-incongruent < 0.15
# - first bin accuracy incongruent-incongruent > 0.6
```{r}
param_sets <- expand.grid(
  b = unique(datAll$b), mu_c = unique(datAll$mu_c), 
  A1 = unique(datAll$A1), A2 = unique(datAll$A2), 
  tau1 = unique(datAll$tau1), tau2 = unique(datAll$tau2)
)

# mean ERs, RTs per parameter set & congruency
ers_rts <- aggregate(
  cbind(error, rt) ~ A1 + A2 + tau1 + tau2 + b + mu_c + congruency, datAll, mean
)
caf_data <- datAll %>% 
  group_by(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, mu_c, b, congruency) %>% 
  mutate(rt_bin = ntile(rt, 5)) %>%
  group_by(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, mu_c, b, congruency, rt_bin) %>% 
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(1-error), mean_rt = mean(rt), .groups = "drop")

# add mean ER and first bin accuracy in i-i
param_sets <- param_sets %>% 
  left_join(
    ers_rts %>% 
      filter(congruency == "incongruent_incongruent") %>% 
      select(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, b, mu_c, error_ii = error), 
    by = c("A1", "A2", "tau1", "tau2", "b", "mu_c")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    caf_data %>% 
      filter(congruency == "incongruent_incongruent", rt_bin == 1) %>% 
      select(A1, A2, tau1, tau2, b, mu_c, mean_acc_bin1_ii = mean_acc), 
    by = c("A1", "A2", "tau1", "tau2", "b", "mu_c")
  )
head(param_sets)

param_sets |> sort_by(~ list(-mean_acc_bin1_ii)) # sort by highest 
param_sets |> sort_by(~ list(mean_acc_bin1_ii)) # sort by lowest 

# select OK parameter sets  
param_sets_OK <- param_sets[
  param_sets$error_ii < 0.15 & param_sets$mean_acc_bin1_ii > 0.6, 
]
str(param_sets_OK)

# D score
param_sets_OK$diffs <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(param_sets_OK)) {
  print(paste("processing set :", i))
  param_sets_OK[i, ]$diffs <- check_ceff(
    datAll, param_sets_OK[i,]$A1, param_sets_OK[i,]$A2, 
    param_sets_OK[i,]$tau1, param_sets_OK[i,]$tau2, 
    param_sets_OK[i,]$mu_c, param_sets_OK[i,]$b
  )
}
save(param_sets_OK, file = "out/data/param_sets_OK.RData")
```

```{r}
dat <- get(load("out/data/param_sets_OK.RData"))
nrow(dat)
summary(dat$diffs)
hist(dat$diffs)

# UA/OA patterns
dat_UA <- dat[dat$diffs > 0, ]
dat_OA <- dat[dat$diffs < s0, ]
nrow(dat_UA)
nrow(dat_OA)
#nrow(param_sets_OK) - nrow(dat_UA) - nrow(dat_OA)


# Plot heatmaps for differences, vary taus
plot_df_1 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.6 & dat$b == 60, ]
plot_df_2 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.5 & dat$b == 60, ]
plot_df_3 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.6 & dat$b == 70, ]
plot_df_4 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.5 & dat$b == 70, ]
plot_df_5 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.6 & dat$b == 50, ]
plot_df_6 <- dat[dat$A1 == dat$A2 & dat$mu_c == 0.5 & dat$b == 50, ]

plot_df_taus <- function(plot_df) {
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(tau2), y = factor(tau1), fill = diffs)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") + theme_minimal() + 
    labs(x = expression(tau[2]), y = expression(tau[1])) +
    facet_wrap(~ A1, 
               labeller = label_bquote(paste(A[1], " = ", A[2], " = ", .(A1)))) + 
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white",high = "orange", 
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-75, 75), name = "D")
}

plot_dfs <- list(plot_df_1, plot_df_2, plot_df_3, plot_df_4, plot_df_5, plot_df_6)
pdf("../../script/images/heatmaps_varyTaus_OK.pdf", 6, 4)
lapply(plot_dfs, plot_df_taus)
dev.off()
```
